encounter: Magma Hideout admin/leader climax, cap 60 (play_order 226-228: E0337 Tabitha, E0339 Maxie)
availability_audit: Every member's pool-60 gate is 60 or lower and its source map lies at or before the Magma Hideout in play order. Tapu Bulu gate 60, legendary_sign:Route123 (the Lilycove-side stretch walked immediately before Mt Pyre). Venusaur gate 36 (evolution:level from Ivysaur) with ITEM_VENUSAURITE stone-window 14. Urshifu-Single-Strike gate 42 (evolution:other:EVO_SCRIPT_TRIGGER from Kubfu, the same tower quest as the Rapid Strike form). Landorus gate 42, legendary_sign:Route111_RuinsExterior. Amoonguss gate 42 (evolution:level from Foongus). Tornadus gate 60, legendary_sign:Route119 - the Fortree route, which the player crosses before the Feather Badge and therefore long before this hideout. Excluded as post-hideout: Suicune (Route125), Tapu Fini (Route126), Keldeo (Route127) and every stone-window-60 Mega placed on the sea routes or the Mossdeep side.
plan: A deliberate rebuild for Tabitha and Maxie, replacing the rain six used for the grunt rooms. Two of Tabitha's members punish Water specifically - Volcanion's Water Absorb heals on it and Coalossal's Steam Engine converts a Water attack into +6 Speed - so this party carries no Water attack at all. Grass is the through-line instead: Tapu Bulu and Mega Venusaur hit Gigalith, Excadrill, Krookodile, Golurk and Great Tusk for 2x, and Mega Venusaur's Thick Fat halves the Fire damage that Coalossal, Volcanion, Ninetales, Chi-Yu, Ceruledge and Pyroar all deal. Landorus is the special Ground lane that is 2x into Gigalith, Excadrill, Coalossal and Volcanion and 4x into Salazzle. Urshifu-Single-Strike replaces the Rapid Strike form precisely so its Unseen Fist Protect-breaking and guaranteed crits arrive on a Dark and Fighting body rather than a Water one - Wicked Blow is 2x into Golurk's Ghost half and Close Combat is 2x into four of Tabitha's six. Amoonguss buys turns. Tornadus is the answer to Maxie: Prankster Taunt moves before a zero-Speed Stakataka in normal order and denies Trick Room outright.
